name: Idealny Simbioz
source:
A cursed island in the middle of nowhere has ruined many lives. The protagonist finds herself deprived of food, companionship, and her former status, left entirely alone. It would seem the only remaining outcome is inevitable death, but at the last moment, a mysterious girl manages to save her. Of course, everything in life comes with a price.

[Translated from [url=https://vngames.ru/novels/detail/symbiosis-perfecta-demo/]vngames.ru[/url]]
translation:
一座荒无人烟的被诅咒的岛屿毁掉了许多人的生命。主角发现自己被剥夺了食物、陪伴和以前的地位，完全孤身一人。似乎唯一剩下的结局就是不可避免的死亡，但在最后一刻，一个神秘的女孩设法拯救了她。当然，生活中的一切都是有代价的。

[译自[url=https://vngames.ru/novels/detail/symbiosis-perfecta-demo/]vngames.ru[/url]]
